newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Micrel a strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Micrel a strong buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it raised its rating on shares of Micrel Inc, a supplier of high performance analog and mixed signal integrated circuits, to a strong buy from a buy.
-- In a statement, Hambrecht said the move is based on a "conviction in the company's growth prospects and in its ability to deliver growth in a stable and predictable manner."
-- Hambrecht said it is confident Micrel will reach earnings estimates of $0.29/shr on sales of $20.5 million in the current quarter.
